newsList.title: Welcome to the game!
newsList.body: Welcome to Plants vs. Zombies! Start your adventure by playing Chapter 1.

newsList.title: New zombie: Buckethead!
newsList.body: The Buckethead zombie has high armor. Use explosive plants to defeat it.

newsList.title: New plant: Snow Pea!
newsList.body: Snow Pea slows down zombies with its icy peas.

newsList.title: Chapter 2 Unlocked!
newsList.body: You have unlocked Chapter 2: Ice Caves. New zombies and plants await!

newsList.title: New Minigame: Vasebreaker!
newsList.body: Try the new Vasebreaker minigame. Break vases to find plants and defeat zombies.

newsList.title: Welcome to the game!

newsList.title: New zombie: Buckethead!
newsList.body: The Buckethead zombie has high armor. Use explosive plants to defeat it.

newsList.title: New plant: Snow Pea!
newsList.body: Snow Pea slows down zombies with its icy peas.

newsList.title: Chapter 2 Unlocked!

newsList.title: New Minigame: Vasebreaker!
